reviews.Author: Babs
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on April 4, 2016
reviews.Text: I purchased this finishing salt to use as a final step before putting my bread in the oven. We enjoy the salty crunch that just a dusting of finishing salt provides on the finished crust. This salt, however, was too coarse to use on my bread. It is a heavier, larger flake; not the fine, light as air flake that I typically use as finishing salt.
reviews.Title: A little too coarse
